case_name: Rakesh @ Bhura Rajak vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
author: Chief Justice

paragraphs.text:
INHERENT JURISDICTION

 REVIEW PETITION (CRL.) NO. OF 2022
 (Diary No.9265 of 2022)

 SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRL.) NO.4714 OF 2019

 Rakesh @ Bhura Rajak …Petitioner

 Versus

 State of Madhya Pradesh …Respondent

 O R D E R
Application seeking condonation of delay in filing Review Petition is

 allowed.
The concurrent view taken by the Sessions Court and the High Court

 in convicting and sentencing the petitioner for having committed offence

 punishable under Section 302 read with
Section 34
of the Indian Penal Code

 was under challenge before this Court. Having considered the matter, this

Court found no reasons to interfere and the Special Leave Petition was
apparent on record to justify interference.
This Review Petition is, therefore, dismissed.
……………………………….CJI.
[Uday Umesh Lalit]

 ……………………………….J.
 [Ajay Rastogi]
New Delhi;
30th August, 2022.
